analysis-workflow.caption: This guide uses Help examples. Small screen details may look different.
Sign in. Open My analyses, then choose New Analysis.
Enter a name that you can find again later.
Choose how customers wait at your counters.
Choose this when everyone waits in one line for the next free counter.
Choose this when each counter has its own line.
Choose Continue to queue setup. Then open Data and setup.
Choose the file type you need. Download the CSV or XLSX template.
Add your own records to the template. Keep the column names.
Use for planning makes this file the data for your plans and checks.
Review only saves the file for viewing. It is not used for plans.
Choose your file. Then select Upload and process.
If NovaQ names a wrong row, fix that row in your file and upload again.

key-metrics.caption: Select the analysis and file you want to read.
This is the average wait from arrival until service starts in your records.
Without both times, NovaQ cannot show recorded wait. Unavailable does not mean zero.
This is the wait NovaQ calculates from your uploaded inputs.
For one shared line, periods where counters cannot keep up are left out.
If any separate line cannot keep up, no overall estimated average is shown.
These answer different questions. The estimate is not a promise about tomorrow.
NovaQ first lists periods where counters cannot keep up.
Then it shows the highest estimated average wait, not one customer's longest wait.
This period has the most arrivals per hour. Separate lines are added together.
Select the information icon beside a metric to read its meaning.
Choose a Time to see the rows for that period.
For separate lines, use Service line to focus on one counter line.
The filters change the table. The top Key results still describe the file.
Select a time block to focus on that period.
The colors use fixed busy levels. They are not a score for your staff.
Busy levels are guide labels. Your plan has its own target.
Open Inputs and model when you need the detailed inputs.
In Reports, choose Download Excel for the calculation details.

queue-simulation.caption: Open Queue simulation and select the right analysis.
Current uses the counters in your planning file. Suggested plan uses your selected plan.
Open Suggested plans. Save and select a plan with Use this plan.
Key results shows numbers. Replay shows the run. Checks and decision tests the plan.
Read the run type. Do not treat separate periods as one continuous day.
Before a shared-line full-day run, check what happens at closing time.
Choose whether to serve everyone in line or leave waiting customers unserved at closing.
Open Advanced settings. Set Random seed to 42 to follow this example.
Repeated days sets how many times the full day runs.
Select Run full operation. Wait for Done.
For separate lines, read the run type and break warning before using the results.
Read the units and notes before you compare Current with Suggested plan.
Average wait uses all served customers across the repeated days.
This card averages each day's longest line. Brackets show the lowest and highest day.
Under the stop-at-closing rule, these customers were still waiting and were not served.
Use matching settings to compare Current and Suggested plan.
Select Replay to view the saved run.
The full-day replay shows one repeated day, not the average of all days.
Select Play to watch. Select Pause to stop.
Choose a slower Speed if the replay is hard to follow.
Step moves to the next event. Restart returns to the beginning.
Watch how many customers arrived, are waiting, are being served, and have finished.
Select Checks and decision. Keep Suggested plan selected.
Use the check settings required by your study. Read Required and Optional.
Many variations tests changes in how fast customers arrive and get served.
Select Check the plan. Wait for the checks to finish.
Read which periods passed, failed, or need more evidence.
Read the answer and its reason. Revise means change the plan first.
If data, setup or plan changes, rerun the steps needed for current results.
Open Reports to download the results with their warnings.
